Select IC50 activity records with provenance for tylophorine and its salts against RAW264.7. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL493620. Retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include canonical_smiles via LEFT JOIN compound_structures. Filter for target CHEMBL612557 and standard_type IC50. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate.
